item.title: Cable TV Pioneers opens call for nominations
item.description: The Cable TV Pioneers is now accepting nominations for its Class of 2026 as the organization nears its 60-year milestone. #pressrelease

item.title: Ergen 'disappointed' by lawsuits lobbed at Dish
item.description: EchoStar President and CEO Charlie Ergen said he's frustrated by an array of lawsuits targeting Dish by tower owners and connectivity providers, claiming Dish has settled 'hundreds of contracts' through negotiation.

item.title: Rural Tower Cooperative says pre-screened sites can accelerate BEAD projects
item.description: The Rural Tower Cooperative says it has achieved faster conversion rates for BEAD with a pre-screening process. #pressrelease

item.title: Smartphone satellite direct-to-device service revenue to approach $12 billion by 2030 – Omdia
item.description: 6G is set to become the first mobile communications system to integrate non-terrestrial network (NTN) technologies natively. #pressrelease

item.title: Ekinops enables O2 Telefónica highest availability, speeds for fixed mobile B2B connectivity services
item.description: The promise is to make sure outdoor coverage matches indoor coverage and deployment is achieved in record time. #pressrelease

item.title: ZTE showcases full-stack AI innovations at MWC Barcelona 2026
item.description: ZTE will highlight deep integration of AI and ICT in four core areas: AI Agentic Connectivity, AI Cloud, AI Home and Smart Personal Devices. #pressrelease

item.title: SoftBank Corp. announces telco AI cloud vision to build social infrastructure for AI era
item.description: It integrates large-scale AI data center platform powered by a GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) cloud, an AI-RAN-based MEC (Multi-access Edge Computing) platform, and a software stack for AI data centers. #pressrelease

item.title: Mycom, Mavenir announce strategic collaboration for delivering agentic AI benefits to CSPs to support autonomous networks L4/5
item.description: Agent-to-Agent integration designed to enable autonomous and semi-autonomous detection, diagnosis, and remediation of network degradations. #pressrelease

item.title: Wind River, Vodafone collaborate to advance AI-RAN operations at scale for Open RAN
item.description: Joint solution showcases how AI-RAN can reduce detection times from hours to minutes and enable the shift toward autonomous network operations. #pressrelease

item.title: SKT unveils AI transformation plan to tackle looming 'crisis'
item.description: Korean operator SK Telecom has outlined plans for AI-led transformation to avert what it calls a looming crisis, with CEO Jung Jai-hun reportedly telling local media the company will spend billions of dollars to rebuild its systems and services.
